get.description: Read a page of objects of a specified type in your HubSpot account. You can control the data returned by specifying which properties to include using the `properties` query parameter. This endpoint supports pagination and can return archived records if specified.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

parameters.name: associations
parameters.description: A comma separated list of object types to retrieve associated IDs for. If any of the specified associations do not exist, they will be ignored.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to display per page.

parameters.name: properties
parameters.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned in the response. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored.

parameters.name: propertiesWithHistory
parameters.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned along with their history of previous values. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored. Usage of this parameter will reduce the maximum number of objects that can be read by a single request.

post.description: Create a CRM object with the specified properties and return a copy of the object, including its ID. This endpoint is useful for adding new objects to your CRM system, allowing you to define properties during creation. The response includes the newly created object details.

Location.description: URL of the newly created resource

post.description: Archive a batch of CRM objects by their IDs. This endpoint allows you to move multiple objects to the archive in a single request, which can be useful for managing large datasets or performing bulk operations efficiently.

Create a batch of CRM objects with specified properties and return the created objects, including their IDs. This endpoint is useful for efficiently adding multiple objects to your CRM in a single request.

Read a batch of CRM objects by their internal IDs or unique property values. This endpoint is useful for retrieving multiple objects in a single request, which can be more efficient than making individual requests for each object. The response includes the objects' details, and you can specify whether to include archived objects.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

post.description: Update a batch of CRM objects in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to modify multiple objects at once by providing their details in the request body. It is useful for making bulk updates efficiently. The response includes the status of each update operation, and any errors encountered during the process.

Create or update a batch of CRM objects by their unique property values in your HubSpot account. This operation allows you to efficiently manage multiple objects at once, ensuring that existing objects are updated and new objects are created as needed.

Permanently delete a contact and all associated content to comply with GDPR regulations. This operation ensures that the contact's data is fully removed. You can specify the contact by their email address using the 'idProperty' set to 'email'. If the email address is not found, it will be added to a blocklist to prevent future use.

Merge two CRM objects of the same type in your HubSpot account. This operation combines the properties of the specified objects, resulting in a single unified object. It is useful for consolidating duplicate records and ensuring data consistency.

Search CRM objects of a specified type using the provided search criteria. This endpoint allows you to specify filters, sorting, and properties to be returned in the search results. It is useful for retrieving specific objects based on complex queries.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

parameters.name: associations

parameters.description: The name of a property whose values are unique for this object type

parameters.name: properties
parameters.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned in the response. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored.

parameters.name: propertiesWithHistory

delete.description: Move an Object identified by `{objectId}` to the recycling bin. This operation allows you to archive a specific CRM object, making it inactive but not permanently deleting it from the system.

patch.description: Perform a partial update of an object identified by `objectId`. The `objectId` refers to the internal object ID by default, or optionally any unique property value as specified by the `idProperty` query parameter. Provided property values will be overwritten, while read-only and non-existent properties will be ignored. Properties can be cleared by passing an empty string.

parameters.description: The name of a property whose values are unique for this object type
